trust_boundary: Static canonical profile descriptions never imply availability. Catalogue availability is a verified block snapshot of the complete frozen set; disabled and unknown differ. Selection triggers fresh verification of the same Wallet-owned release and account, and produces only a display preference. Refresh uses copied host inputs, cleared on invalidation. No new signing, account grant, transaction preparation or execution path. Counterfactual/non-owner account readiness is displayed separately. The checked-in live configuration remains unbound. No end-to-end creation or live qualification asserted.
